headline: Luka 40 Tonight? 1 in 5
caption:
A 40-point game shows up in about 0.9% of games. Our model gives Luka Doncic a 20% shot at one tonight.

That's the most unusual number on the Oct 21 board: more than 20 times the usual rate. Josh Giddey is right behind him, with a 16% triple-double chance against a usual 0.8%.

The rest of the list: Anthony Edwards 40+ at 6.7%, Jalen Johnson triple-double 6.6%, Giannis 40+ 5.3%, Luka triple-double 5.2%, Giannis triple-double 4.8%, Domantas Sabonis triple-double 4.3%. These are chances, not calls. Even at 20%, Luka finishes under 40 four nights in five.

Which lands first: Luka's 40 or Giddey's triple-double?

facts.method: Calibrated probabilities from models tested on seasons they never trained on. 'Usual' is how often this happens in a typical game.
